name: Misaki Suzuka
source:
The main character's class homeroom teacher. She is also a public health doctor.

The previous homeroom teacher was sent to the hospital due to an accident. The assistant homeroom teacher was subsequently hospitalized due to illness and was assigned in her place.

It is rumored that Suzuka herself was involved in these events, but the truth is not known.

It is said that Suzuka is quite mature and feminine....

[From [url=http://www.teck.co.jp/gj/products/q_bon/chara/gense.html]official site[/url]]
